attempts.text:
The plan below rescues all 11 people with no deferrals, for a total cost of 122 minutes. Gosaikunda school is not an evacuation point, so every drop-off happens at Naukunda shelter. The car makes one round trip to Myagang for the three elderly residents (10 minutes) and two round trips to Gosaikunda school for the four injured and four children (56 minutes each).

<plan>
drive car1 naukunda-shelter myagang-care-home
load car1 elderly 3
drive car1 myagang-care-home naukunda-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
drive car1 naukunda-shelter gosaikunda-school
load car1 injured 4
drive car1 gosaikunda-school naukunda-shelter
unload car1 injured 4
drive car1 naukunda-shelter gosaikunda-school
load car1 child 4
drive car1 gosaikunda-school naukunda-shelter
unload car1 child 4
</plan>
COST: 122
